g.text: Wire colours at plug A: pin1 green = 5V (from brake board), pin2 red = DOUT (brake command), pin3/pin4 yellow+black = GND and speed pulse, order to be measured (session 3).

g.desc: Wire colours at plug A: pin1 green = 5V (from brake board), pin2 red = DOUT (brake command), pin3/pin4 yellow+black = GND and speed pulse, order to be measured (session 3).

g.text: SNIFF mode: console plugged into J2, JP1 open, ESP32 listens (GPIO25/26/34). DRIVE mode: console unplugged, JP1 closed, ESP32 drives DOUT via Q1.

g.desc: SNIFF mode: console plugged into J2, JP1 open, ESP32 listens (GPIO25/26/34). DRIVE mode: console unplugged, JP1 closed, ESP32 drives DOUT via Q1.

g.text: Crosstrainer adapter board: ESP32 <-> console link (4-pin SENSOR plug at the top of the column)

g.desc: Crosstrainer adapter board: ESP32 <-> console link (4-pin SENSOR plug at the top of the column)

g.text: J1 Plug A = column side (JST SM 4p female)

g.desc: J1 Plug A = column side (JST SM 4p female)

g.text: Never close JP1 while the console is plugged in. All machine lines reach the ESP32 only through dividers (max 3.3 V).

g.desc: Never close JP1 while the console is plugged in. All machine lines reach the ESP32 only through dividers (max 3.3 V).

g.text: D1: machine 5 V -> ESP32 5V/VIN (~4.7 V). USB may stay connected during sniffing.

g.desc: D1: machine 5 V -> ESP32 5V/VIN (~4.7 V). USB may stay connected during sniffing.

g.text: J2 console pass-through (JST SM 4p male), SNIFF mode only

g.desc: J2 console pass-through (JST SM 4p male), SNIFF mode only

g.text: Common ground: machine GND (plug A pin 3 or 4) = ESP32 GND = divider returns = Q1 emitter.

g.desc: Common ground: machine GND (plug A pin 3 or 4) = ESP32 GND = divider returns = Q1 emitter.

g.text: GPIO2: on-board LED, heartbeat. USB: serial console 115200, flashing.

g.desc: GPIO2: on-board LED, heartbeat. USB: serial console 115200, flashing.

g.text: GPIO16 (UART2 RX) only if DOUT turns out to be serial: connect to CAPTURE node.

g.desc: GPIO16 (UART2 RX) only if DOUT turns out to be serial: connect to CAPTURE node.

g.text: If the brake board accepts 3.3 V logic (session 4), Q1/R7/R8 may be replaced by a 100R series link; keep JP1.

g.desc: If the brake board accepts 3.3 V logic (session 4), Q1/R7/R8 may be replaced by a 100R series link; keep JP1.

g.text: Driver (DRIVE mode only): GPIO27 PWM is inverted by Q1; firmware uses 'pwm inv on'.

g.desc: Driver (DRIVE mode only): GPIO27 PWM is inverted by Q1; firmware uses 'pwm inv on'.

g.text: BC547 TO-92, flat side facing you: C B E

g.desc: BC547 TO-92, flat side facing you: C B E
